reviews.text: They just opened and they took good care of my 2 babys everyone was so nice and free coffee

We recently moved from the Mainline to the city's Riverward area and needed to find a new vet for our pooches. I'm so glad we found Indy! It's within walking distance, which is fantastic, and the three vets are phenomenal. They all take their time and answer all of your questions. After 20+ years with our old vet, I never thought I'd recommend another practice, but the folks at Indy are so great that it's easy to do.

Our cat Lola was under the care of Dr.Sarah Organist and Dr. Eric Matkowski for several years now and we want to thank them both and their enormously  competent and caring Staff. Unfortunately, Lola is no longer with us. We want people to know how kind, compassionate and helpful they were. Our experience with Indy Vet has  been nothing but positive in every way. They spend the time to help not only the animals that they treat but the caretakers also.  Their  patience , professionalism and generosity with their time is exceptional and has helped relieve some of the anguish of losing a loved and cherished pet. They have always been there for us and have taken the time with our dogs and our other cats as well.  Thank you Indy for your professional help, expertise and above all your kindness and understanding.

Indy has been a great find! They took care of my dog when I fostered him and I continued with them after I adopted him because he was getting such great care. He feels like a star every time he goes in there and they always have good information. We’ve been dealing with his epilepsy and each doctor was conscientious of cost as they recommended follow-up tests. I’m confident he is getting great care and they aren’t angling for an upsell.
I bring all of my pets here. Big fan of Dr. Eric. Can’t think of what to say besides I really trust them with my furry little loved ones.

Brought my new 2 year old rescue pittie there for his first checkup with us. The staff is amazing! Knowledgeable, patient and extraordinarily helpful. The wait was short and pleasant, and the facility is immaculate. Feel blessed to have this place so close to home

We love Dr. Sarah and Dr. Eric. We have been coming here for years with our many animals and always get the best care. Dr. Sarah helped us with our very reactive rescue dog who was aggressive. She is always super patient and empathetic. Through trial and error we found the right medicine combo and now our dog is thriving and able to have a better quality life. We have not had a bite incident in over a year now and he is such a happy boy. Would definitely recommend Indy Vet to anyone!

My 2 cats and new dog see Dr. Eric because he is the BEST! He is friendly, professional and takes the time to explain everything you need to know. He's like extended family. Also, the team is professional. We never have to wait long which is great to for the fur babies. I highly recommend Dr. Eric and his team at Indy Vet!
I have taken several of my pets to Indy…all of the vets and Techs are excellent, knowledgeable and compassionate…I recommend them to all I know

Excellent experience! Dr. Eric took the time to explain everything in great detail and answered all of my questions patiently. You can truly tell that he genuinely cares about animals rather than treating each appointment like just another routine visit. I also really appreciated the detailed notes and recommendations he provided after the exam—they showed how much thought and care went into my cats’ health. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of my two girls. I highly recommend Indy Veterinary Care!
Great doctors and vet staff, super kind and helpful. Front desk girl could definitely use a snickers or just a nap fr
Lovely office. Everyone is very nice. Dr Eric is very thorough. We found our new veterinarian home !🥰
Amazing experience, very clean, very friendly and professional. Brought my Pembroke welsh corgi

I was referred to Indy by another satisfied customer. They were so patient while listening to all my concerns and questions. I was so nervous about making a decision for PU surgery and I felt very heard, understood and empathized with. I feel I am making a reasonable decision to hold off on surgery, based on my cats behavior and history. I genuinely felt the vet wanted what's best for my cat. All my questions were patiently answered, I didn't feel rushed at all. The waiting room is clean and quiet.  I look forward to continuing my cat's care at Indy Vet. I recommend Indy Vet because they completely understood where I was coming from and listened patiently as I discussed my cat's history. They did not push unneeded tests.  The cost of the appointment was very affordable.

Everyone is great here! They weee so sweet to my crazy ass dog & took the very best care of her. They also helped me out incredibly as a firestone dog owner about a lot of things i had no idea dogs even needed. They know what they are talking about and genuinely love animals
Was assigned a room promptly and dr. Sara Organist is knowledgeable and empathetic.
Secret, hopeful, and grateful to respond to the need a of my pet .

Best vet experience I’ve had with my cat Violet. We recently moved to the area and are so happy we found this vet right away. Sesley at the front desk was friendly and got us in a room right away. We didn’t have to wait long before our tech Casey came in and took her time asking questions and making sure Violet was comfortable. The exam with Dr. Eric was educational and we didn’t feel rushed at all. They really care here and take their time with you. I def recommend to anyone looking for a stress free vet visit! :)

Always tacking on extra meds and procedures that weren’t in the best interest of our pets. We switch to a new vet and even they called out that Indy Vet should not have recommended & preformed “solutions” to our pets “illnesses”. From unnecessary blood tests to over prescribing meds. Highly advise looking else where for your pets care.
They have been my go to vet for years! Very nice place with great staff and attention to detail.
Dr Eric and Dr Sarah are the best!

My dog is very reactive but warms up with time, and the Indy vet staff is the only practice that’s taken the time and practiced enough patience to see him. He was years overdue for routine vaccines and they got it taken care of. So much appreciation to the entire staff! ❤️

All three doctors are absolutely amazing. They take their time to listen to what’s going on with your pet and provide the best treatment plan with all the detail you need. I never feel as though I’m being rushed out the door or encouraged to purchase a service my dog doesn’t need. Their prices are also very fair. We’ve been going to Indy for 2.5 years and couldn’t imagine going anywhere else. The doctors and techs are 10/10. The front desk staff are quite cold though. That would be the only complaint I can muster up.

I love Indy Vet! They really do have the best interests of my cats at the front of their mind. The vets and vet techs take their time with my cats, making sure it's the least stressful experience it could be for them. They always clearly communicate their concerns if they have any and work with me to create a care plan. Highly, highly recommend.

I recently left another vet in the neighborhood due to how rude and condescending they were after 6 years and 4 dogs as patients. Indy was a night and day difference. So incredibly kind, professional and you could tell they enjoy working with animals.
We greatly appreciate your 5-star review!

Can't say enough good things about the team at Indy Vet. We have a reactive 75 pound dog and we've never had any issues getting him care here - Dr. Matkowski and Shawna have been so kind and patient to our dog. Highly recommend!
Dr. Eric made end of life care for my cat as easy as it could be. He is compassionate and gentle with the mouth of a sailor. 10/10 would recommend.
Our Rescue Bull Terrier loves Indy Vet and so do we! The staff is kind & knowledgeable and responsive to every need.
Professional, friendly, and efficient

I love Dr. Matkowski at Indy Veterinary Care.  He spends time to make sure I understand not only what he thinks about my pets health but WHY he thinks it!  He is so kind and caring.  He understands the financial reality of pet parents and never pushes unnecessary treatments that do not improve quality of life.  Thank you so much for easing my anxiety!!
Love doctor Erick! He always makes us feel like everything will be ok. Always honest and doesn't force treatments or medication on us. Indy is highly recommended as far as I am concerned!
Thank you for your 5-star review!

Very thorough exam by the vet, took time to explain things.
Friendly, helpful staff.
Excellence!  Dr Eric is wonderful and did an outstanding job spaying Star Bright my cat.  My thanks to Dr Eric, the surgery tech and the entire staff.  I am more than pleased.

Dr. Organist has seen our three dogs through, quite literally, all stages of their lives. She cared for them with compassion through anxiety/behavioral issues, dental cleanings, strange growths, herniated discs, old age, and end of life care. We have been consistently grateful for her meticulous, thoughtful, and kind approach.

Always have a wonderful experience at Indy vet and we've been to multiple vets in Philadelphia. We have a VERY vet anxious cat. Indy vet initially helped w home visits, then more recently helped me get my cat seen in their office efficiently without prolonged waits and understanding my cats anxiety. I appreciate their expertise. They always leave me feeling super confident/comfortable in my animal's care plan. I now drive over an hour each way to see them.
Have taken all my animals here for years, they are the best
Thank you for your 5 star review. We appreciate it!
We greatly appreciate your 5-star review!

Indy Veterinary Care is truly exceptional. The staff is incredibly kind, the vets are knowledgeable, reassuring, and genuinely supportive, and you never feel rushed. I recently moved to the area and had to walk in urgently when my pup Mason got sick without an appointment. They took care of him immediately and made sure he got exactly what he needed to feel better. They are absolutely excellent with animals. You can tell they truly love what they do and treat every pet as if it were their own. I trust them completely, and that peace of mind is priceless. I can honestly say I’ve never had a vet experience like this before.

I feel so grateful knowing both Mason and Jackson are in such caring, capable hands. I’ve officially found my new vet for as long as I’m here. If you’re looking for a veterinary practice that goes above and beyond.. HIGHLY RECOMMEND making Indy Veterinary Care your vet!
We have fallen in love with Indy Veterinary Care. Every person treats us and our cats with respect and care. They know their stuff this is the only place we will go.

There is a huge disconnect between their back of house and what happens up front. The vets can tell you one thing during an exam and the front of house will not follow up or follow through with the plan.

I chose Indy Vet purely based off of their rave reviews on google after doing research on all of the vet offices in Philly. They have incredible front-desk staff and Dr. Eric was amazing with my cat, Frankie! I arrived a few minutes early to my appointment and they brought us to a room immediately. This is the first time I haven't had to wait forever to be seen for a pre-booked vet appointment! I wasn't sure how long the appointment was going to be but we used up the full hour discussing her as Dr. Eric is very thorough and attentive with answering my questions. I absolutely recommend the Indy Vet team and Dr. Eric for the care of your furbaby!
Dr. Eric and the entire staff were amazing. The facilities were spotless and everyone was extremely kind and made me and my cat feel completely at ease. I'm very glad to have found them.
Definitely had better vet experiences…

Dr Eric has to be one of the top 1% of humans in this World. The whole staff is wonderful, showing compassion and just wanting to make sure you and your doggy are taken care of. Can not recommend Indy Vet Care enough.
Exceptional service and beautiful office. Highly recommended!

I absolutely love Dr. Sara and the staff at Indy! My dog Lulu is very fearful, and going to the vet used to be so stressful, but now it’s no longer traumatic for either of us. Dr. Sara is amazing—so gentle, patient, and thorough—and the whole team is incredibly kind. They never rush you, and you can truly feel how much they care every time you go in. They always communicate quickly, emails are answered fast, and getting Lulu the medicine she needs is stress free. I’ve had animals my whole life, and I can honestly say I’ve never loved a vet as much as I do here. Can’t recommend them enough!!

I have been taking my cat here for several years and I have always had positive experiences. I particularly like Dr. Eric's approach -- he fully explains what symptoms he notices, what they could mean, and the steps he would take if it were his pet. For any suggested medications, tests, or treatments, he walks through each option, the science behind it, and what I should expect. The front desk staff have always been wonderful, and the prices are fair.

Since July I have had the pleasure of taking my senior rescue dog to both Dr Eric and Dr Sara. We first saw Dr Eric in order to get a 2nd opinion on the order of operations (so to speak) in order to address Goddi’s mammary masses. She was not spayed until she ended up at the shelter in spring / summer of 2024, which puts her at greater risk of mammary cancer.

Our usual vet, who is wonderful but perhaps not as attentive as I’d like for a senior animal, had brushed them off for months until I urged them to feel her belly again, then insisted we do surgery followed by a chest x-ray within 3 months.

I was concerned about her getting surgery due to her heart murmur and age and didn’t feel like those were being taken into consideration as carefully as I’d like. So, we got a 2nd opinion!

Dr Eric was extremely informative upon our first visit and made recommendations such as seeing a cardiologist to get her cleared for surgery and doing the chest x-ray prior to surgery.

As soon as we got the go ahead from the cardiologist, I scheduled her surgery which was with Dr Sara, who also did her bloodwork and chest x-ray.

In-take and communication leading up to surgery day was extremely professional and compassionate — both Dr Sara and Dr Eric (as well as other team members!) were quick to answer my many questions and answered with great detail and in a way that was easy for me to understand.

Obviously, a major surgery like this is scary for us owners with any animal at any age but I felt like the Indy team really took extra care with the recommended steps and precautions (but not in a $$$ milking way!) Her surgery was well inline with the initial estimate I was provided and they even helped offer ways we could get the cost down while not impacting Goddi’s health or treatment.

The front desk team also texted me when her surgery started and when it ended. And Dr Sara called me right after to provide a run down of how things went and what was found (mammary masses & inguinal hernia). The tech (sorry if this is the incorrect title) working also went to school for anesthesiology I believe and trains other vet techs. She said Goddi did unbelievably well under anesthesia :)

I cannot thank this team enough for making such a tough experience / decision for both my Goddi girl and myself so much easier. Not knowing Goddi’s exact age or medical history complicated the path to get here but I am so glad she ended up in the right hands.

After this experience, we might be switching from our usual vet to Indy 😅
My wife loves them and still travels from Mt Airy for care for our Dog and cat.
Could not recommend this place enough! Everyone in this office kind, organized, professional. The vets also provide exceptional care and take the time to explain options. Thank you for all you do!
I love this office, the vets are so kind and informative.
The very best veterinary clinic! Such a passionate group of professionals from the front desk to the doctors. Special thanks to Shawna who stayed after hours to help us with our dog Oscar!

The rescue our pup was at has a relationship with this vet. Everyone was very nice and took great care of our boy. I would definitely recommend this place if you are looking for Veterinary care for your four legged family.

Dr. Organist has taken care of our 8 year old doxin min pin since he was a puppy. We could not be more grateful for the detailed, quality care she provides every time. She has excellent bedside manner and is extremely patient/loving with our dog! She fairly charges and i recommend her to any animal owner she is by far the best vet we’ve ever had.

Dr Sara is an amazing person and vet. Our dog Spartacus was diagnosed with an advanced form of Lymphoma. Unfortunately Spartacus had to be put to sleep this past week. This was my first experience having to put a dog to sleep. My boyfriend has been through it many times, but I had no idea what to expect. Compared to other vet experiences, he expressed this was by far the most professional and compassionate experience given how  sad the day was. Her entire team was compassionate and caring to the very end. Dr Sara and her team were respectful of our grief, and trepidations, and gave us the time we needed to say goodbye. The doctor stayed with us and in the end our dog was at peace with no more pain and that is all we could ask for. In the months leading up to this they were responsive and understanding that we chose the path of palliative care. They did not try to push expensive treatments on us or give us a guilt trip. For such a sad experience they really made the best of it. And of course while our dog was alive they were very good with regular checkups and highly recommend choosing Indy Vet for all your pet needs. Thank you Dr Sara, we do not know how you do it, but please keep up the great work!

Greatest Doctor Duo with excellent support staff. Reliable, accurate, caring and I would say one of the top three vets I've been to in last 25 years. But this combo puts them over the top to an easy #1

I feel so lucky to have found Indy Vet. My dog means the world to me, so it is so important to feel like he is in good hands. I looked for a long time for a vet I felt like I could trust, and Dr. Eric always goes above and beyond, spending time to answer all of my questions in detail with so much thoughtfulness and knowledge. Very grateful.

Indy has been my primary vet for years. Staff is incredibly understanding and cooperative, always going the extra mile to cater to our needs. Doctors have always been cooperative and clear about treatment plan/cost. My golden and I love it here!
Thank you for your 5 star review!

Wonderful facility! Staff and veterinarians are very friendly, informative and helpful. I have continued to bring my dogs here even after moving across the city because I really trust them and enjoy the safe and supportive environment they’ve created. Dr. Eric is particularly great, he really goes above and beyond to explain treatment options and ensure my understanding.
I love taking my dachshund to Indy Vet, they are so thorough and gentle with him and their staff is always a pleasure as well!
Indy Vet is beyond amazing. I am so so happy with the care my pom Nico has received with Dr. Eric. He is truly a wonderful vet and you can tell he truly cares for his patients.
We love Dr. Sarah and Indy Vet! The care has been thorough, thoughtful and top notch throughout the 5+ years we’ve been taking our dog here. Highly recommend for all pets and care needs !

This place is the best! Took my kitten for his second appointment today — and I haven’t been able to stop talking about what a positive experience it was! Dr.Eric is very informative, knowledgeable, personable and caring. He’s very transparent with cost and ways to keep appointments budget friendly as well as being open to any questions I might have. Highly recommend Indy Vet — very affordable for such great quality care.
Very professional. Took time with my pet and I. Answered all my questions. Took me at my appointment time. Great!
Super friendly and compassionate doctors, nurses, and staff. We have a small dog with high stress and she love it, never gets anxious. Highly recommended!
Excellent

After some bad vet experiences, this was a dream for a very anxious cat parent and two older cats.  Dr. Eric and team were knowledgable, respectful of my requests and efficient.  They didn't encourage any excessive testing.  10/10 recommend and will return!
Best vet in the city. My entire family goes there with our fur babies, both big and small.
Best vet experience I've had in decades!

I absolutely love this place!! My dog Betty is fearful and anxious and through the pandemic, they came to our home. Since then, we see them in clinic where they are so patient and kind. Today, I showed up for my 10:30 appointment, which was actually supposed to be tomorrow! They saw us anyway. I recently moved and drive all the way from Cape May to see them. Cannot speak more highly of the staff and care here!
Thank you for your 5 star review!

I have gone there previously and had fabulous experiences, but for the annual I was quite unimpressed. The entire appointment for my 2 dogs was 45 minutes, I had to ask for Dr Sara to come back in because she never looked in their ears or eyes. She proceeded to say she did, but I never saw any otoscope so how could she have? The techs didn’t tell me where the vaccines were given, nor blood, had to ask. It was their first annual there and Dr. Sara didn’t even feel over their bodies enough to question / physically examine some of the bumps / lumps that we monitor size of yearly. I was never even asked if I had any questions or anything else I needed, so had to ask for prescriptions since no vets in the city carry the prescription brands in house. They also decided to run a blood test in house since it was the same cost for out of house for faster results, but I am more so hoping they picked the place with the better instrument used..that’s more what matters when looking for the results. Also when I walked in for my appointment, two other people walked in behind me, seemed like it was overbooked and an annual is supposed to be thorough and time consuming to check everything over. Just wasn’t impressed.
Thank you for your 5 star review!
This place is the best. Caring, considerate and compassionate. This team is top grade in terms of vets here in Philly. Thank you
Wow. Great empathy when putting down my past dog. Caring transition into new pup. Staff and Doctors incredible all-around! Thanks, Brownie et all.

We take both our dogs to Indy. Dr. Sara and Dr. Eric are both so compassionate and knowledgeable. We have had a great experience with all the staff each time we go. If we ever reach out between appointments, the team responds very quickly. They are also understanding of our reactive dog and allow us to schedule at low traffic times. We highly recommend Indy vet!

They are the best in everything they do for your pet ...they treat them with such care and kindness...I wouldn't go anywhere else...I followed Dr Matkowski from Levittown,  the best decision I ever made!!

Incredible team of caring professionals! So so thankful we have found this place! Everyone is so wonderful and Dr.Sara took so much time to make sure our little one gets the best and the right care! Highly recommend this place

Seriously the best vet practice I’ve ever been with. They answer questions so promptly via text and made my dog a high priority when we had an emergency. They are kind compassionate and knowledgeable. So thankful for Indy Vet.

Additional shout out to Shauna for keeping a look out for my husband and pup after talking to a very frantic me on the phone.

Indy Vet has always been wonderful to us and our dog, Ace. Ace can be reactive to strangers, and the Indy Vet team has been accommodating and calm anytime they work with us, which puts at ease. We really appreciate the team there, and love Dr. Organist and Dr. Matkowski (the two vets we've worked with, but I'm sure the others are wonderful as well). Thank you for what you do!

Shout out to the two medical assistants that expertly gave Ace his vaccines and did bloodwork! And to Julian at the front desk for being so friendly and nice!

Updated review 4/5/25:
We just had our annual visit for Ace and saw Dr. Matkowski. As always, the whole team was wonderful and we so greatly appreciate everyone being so good with Ace. Thank you, Dr. Matkowski for always keeping it real and being so calm and understanding! All the animals who come to Indy Vet are lucky to have such a caring team.

Love these guys. I am a new cat owner and the guy gave me casual info that ended up saving my cats life. I had one girl and one boy and he said if I ever hear the boy screaming or going back and forth to the litter box, that it's a medical emergency. I would have never known and wouldn't have rushed him to the emergency vet had he not told me this.

Indy Vet Care is the perfect name for how they operate. My puppy has been going there and every vet tech or doctor has passion for their work, is professionally competent, and really cares about the well being of animals. I recently got my dog neutered there and they have been great. Also, I have called in from time to time and they have always answered questions with patience in a helpful way, putting me at ease being a new dog owner. 5/5 stars!
Amazing Vet practice!

The vets/techs were fantastic. My dog gets very nervous and resists his checkup and vaccines, but the staff spent a generous amount of time befriending him with treats and belly rubs before starting. This went a long way to calm him and made the visit go much smoother than it has at other places.The bill/pricing was fair. Recommended for sure.

What a difference from our last experience at 2nd Street in Nolibs.
FULL TIME staff and doctor, CLEAN (!!). Dr Sarah was warm and was very sweet with our little 3.4 lb puppy, Miso. Alexis, her vet tech, was also sweet and again, it was so clean and calm.

We like that this is a private, woman owned practice not a chain operating under a dog insurance company.

This was a night and day experience and similar to our NYC VET.

High end treatment from start to finish. We will be loyal for the life of this 16 week old puppy... 🐩

So grateful to you all and please never leave!

The Haas's, to incl: Miso-happy

First time at Indy Vet was incredible! Scheduling was easy and Dr. Mitchell and staff took wonderful care of my cat, Pepper, and were all extremely kind. The office itself was clean and had a great set up for my cat to explore in her room. …

I’ve been taking my dogs here since I moved to the area. I really like Dr. Eric Matkowski & the staff here. They provide detailed notes from each exam through email. Staff is easy to contact and I really like the availability of appointment too!
